basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Research Scientist II (Mechanical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Mechanical Engineering at IIT Kharagpur has invited online applications for one Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) post in the ICMR-sponsored PRAGATICAR project, for 12 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. Consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 80,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. Candidates need MBBS/BVSc/BDS with 3 years' post-qualification experience, or with an MD/MVSc/MDS/MPH or equivalent PG degree, or with a PhD. The age limit is 40 years and the last date is 9 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications are invited online and must be submitted by 9 December 2026. The notice does not give the web address of the online form or a list of documents to attach. The application fee is Rs. 0 for General/Male/OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates. The notice also says the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.
important_instructions: The notice states that the fee is to be deposited by RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking to: State Bank of India (00202), P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302; account name IIT SRIC-OM Account; account no. 39502115210; IFSC SBIN0000202; SWIFT SBININBB339. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum. The notice is a computer-generated document generated on 25 November 2026 by ERP, IIT Kharagpur, and needs no signature.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints the essential qualification for the post as one of the three options below. MBBS/BVSc/BDS + 3 years post-qualification experience, OR MBBS/BVSc/BDS + MD/MVSc/MDS/MPH or equivalent PG degree, OR MBBS/BVSc/BDS + PhD Desired experience: clinical research, clinical protocol development, patient recruitment, medical-device/diagnostic validation, multicentre studies.

content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 80,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The assignment is temporary and lasts 12 months or until the project is terminated, whichever is earlier.
